text: Do a real research pass on the internet now with the librarian, and download what you find into research/sources/ rather than reasoning from memory. This is a probability problem over a random hyperplane-arrangement/parity structure, and the run has been trying to reach p(n,L) at n=13 by enumeration. Fetch the actual theory rather than more code: bumps-race / Torpids combinatorics if anything exists, and beyond that the general apparatus - random interval and hyperplane arrangement counting, parking-function and ballot-type bijections, transfer-matrix and finite-state methods for counting configurations by parity, exponential generating functions for labelled chronologies, and inclusion-exclusion over crossing patterns. A closed form or a recurrence found in the literature beats another enumeration. Record the source URL in every file you download, and put what each one establishes as a claim block so it reaches research/CLAIMS.md.
